extracted.intended_audience: publishers, academics/researchers, research administrators, medical affairs teams, corporate R&D and non‑profits
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and product features for tracking, visualizing, comparing and reporting online attention to published research across social media, news, policy, patents and other outlets. Intended to support monitoring, reporting, institutional benchmarking and bespoke analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online attention sources tracked
rubrics_metrics.description: Tracks and captures a range of online attention sources to published research across social media, news outlets, policy and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly includes social media, mainstream media/news outlets, policy documents and patents; the platform collates activity from thousands of online mentions every day to reveal where research is being discussed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Altmetric Explorer — access and comparison
rubrics_metrics.description: Access and compare online attention to research, as Altmetric tracks thousands of online mentions across social media, mainstream media, policy, patents and more all in one platform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Explorer to compare attention across outputs, filter/search mentions, and interrogate patterns of dissemination and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Altmetric Badges — visual summary of dissemination
rubrics_metrics.description: Quickly view and understand the dissemination of research at a glance. Each badge compiles and consolidates online attention to research, so you can instantly visualize and interpret online attention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Badges are intended to complement traditional citation analysis by providing an immediate visual summary (e.g., the Altmetric 'doughnut') of attention from varied sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Altmetric API — flexible data & granular queries
rubrics_metrics.description: Leverage Altmetric data in the way that works best for your organization. Conduct more complex searches, ask granular questions, build custom visualizations and merge your own data with the Altmetric API.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: API access supports bespoke analyses, integration with institutional systems, and creation of custom reports or visualizations using Altmetric data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Altmetric Consultancy — customized dashboards & insight
rubrics_metrics.description: Altmetric consultancy creates customized and accurate dashboards in the way you need, with friendly data analysts helping to create a solution based on your exact requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultancy provides tailored, organization‑specific setups, bespoke reporting and analytic support to answer particular questions or uncover new uses of the data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor, report and showcase attention
rubrics_metrics.description: We collate this activity, to help you monitor, report and showcase the attention surrounding the research you care about.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use collated altmetric activity for ongoing monitoring, institutional or funder reporting, and showcasing research influence to stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Move beyond citations — capture broader impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Move beyond citations and listen in on the conversation. Complement traditional citation analysis with Altmetric Badges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Altmetrics are presented as complementary to citation metrics, intended to capture societal, media and policy attention that citations alone miss.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speed / near‑real‑time tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: Reveal online attention to research at speed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed to surface conversations and mentions quickly (thousands of conversations happen online daily), supporting timely awareness and response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sentiment and domain‑specific insights
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources and events (e.g., 'Understanding attention with sentiment in Medical Affairs') indicate attention can be explored with sentiment and domain‑specific interpretation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sentiment analysis and themed insights are used to understand not just volume but tone and relevance for specific audiences such as Medical Affairs teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Benchmarking and institutional use
rubrics_metrics.description: Altmetric is presented as a tool for institutional impact work (e.g., business school accreditation, building institutional impact, academic user days).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply Altmetric data for institutional benchmarking, accreditation evidence, impact strategy, and to support research administrators and leadership in assessing dissemination and influence.
